name: canvas-sketch
role: Browser sketch workbench with hot reload, fixed-size canvases and high-resolution PNG export
summary: Generative-art toolkit by Matt DesLauriers: a CLI scaffolds a sketch module that gets a canvas context, fixed physical dimensions, an animation loop and still export. Works with Canvas 2D, WebGL and Three.js. Marked beta by its author. Its strength is print-sized, reproducible stills; the README documents only PNG export, so frame-exact video capture would need a harness driving the sketch from outside.
use_when: Print-resolution generative stills with exact pixel dimensions and hot reload
Over p5.js when you want plain Canvas 2D or Three.js code with no framework API
Sketch module that exposes time/frame props a harness can drive
Over Ssam when you want the older, widely-copied sketch convention and templates
avoid_when: Video or GIF export out of the box: Ssam or canvas-record
Largest API and example base for beginners: p5.js
Scene graph with many interactive objects: Konva or PixiJS
Wanting a framework-free, no-CLI setup: raw Canvas 2D
notes: 2026-10-26: Video export via the CLI was not confirmed from the README read; only PNG export is documented there.

assessment.rationale: Latest commit and npm release 0.7.8 on 2026-05-26; MIT. Author labels it beta with an unfinished roadmap, but it is maintained and still the reference for the sketch-module pattern that Ssam copies.
